name: AMC Auth Result
description: An outcome screen for authentication and other flows whose inline SVG symbol draws itself inside a glowing orbit ring, a checkmark in a filling ring, a paper plane landing on an envelope, a shield, a door, a draining hourglass, a shaking cross or a latching lock, over optional full-page aurora, meteor, grid, mesh, retro or particle scenes, with an optional countdown redirect.
useFor: A Static Content region on a confirmation page or after a branch from a process: Account created, Password changed, Reset link sent, Email verified, Signed out, Link expired, Something went wrong, Access denied. Region title is the heading, region text is the message with native links, Next or Create is the primary action and Previous or Close the secondary one.
helpText:
Region template for confirmation and outcome screens. The region title is the heading, the region text is the message (use neutral wording such as 'If an account exists for m••••@example.com, we sent a reset link'), links and buttons in the text stay native, Next or Create is the primary action and Previous or Close the secondary one; Help, Edit, Change, Copy and Delete also render in the action bar. Sub regions render in a row below the actions, separated by a dashed line: use one for 'Didn't get it? Resend' on the email outcome.

OUTCOME, tick at most one: none = Success, a checkmark drawn inside a ring that fills. Email sent = a paper plane flies in along its trail and lands on an envelope. Verified = a shield with a check and sparkles. Signed out = a door swings open and an arrow leaves. Link expired = the last sand drains through an hourglass, which then tilts. Error = a cross is drawn in a ring, then a gentle shake. Access denied = a lock whose shackle drops shut, then a shake. Each outcome also shows a text kicker above the heading - Done, Email sent, Verified, Signed out, Expired, Error, Access denied - so the state never depends on color; translate the kickers in the template markup. The symbols are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

LIVE REGION: title, kicker and text sit in a wrapper with role status. With JavaScript, the Link expired, Error and Access denied outcomes switch it to role alert; without JavaScript it stays role status.

LOOK: none = Glass, a frosted card with a light top edge and outcome-colored glow. Minimal = no card, only symbol and text. Split = a two-part card with the symbol on a gradient panel, stacking on narrow widths. Brutal = ink border, hard offset shadow, bold heading.

SCENE, at most one: Aurora, Meteors, Grid, Mesh, Retro or Particles draw a decorative layer fixed behind the whole page, so the Login page template needs no changes; none = no scene. Scenes never receive clicks.

CONFETTI: a small burst from the symbol after it is drawn, for the Success and Verified outcomes only.

REDIRECT AFTER COUNTDOWN: needs the script file. Shows a progress ring and 'Continuing in 5…' and then activates the first link or button in the region text, otherwise the primary button of the region. Set the seconds with Custom Attributes data-amc-seconds="8" - default 5, 1 to 3600. The countdown pauses while the pointer is over the card, while keyboard focus is inside it and while the browser tab is hidden. A visible 'Stay on this page' button and the Escape key cancel it; the cancel button is always shown, also under reduced motion.

STRINGS, overridable with the region Custom Attributes because the first attribute wins: data-amc-text-continuing="Continuing in %0…", data-amc-text-paused="Paused", data-amc-text-cancel="Stay on this page", data-amc-text-cancelled="Automatic redirect cancelled.", data-amc-text-announce="You will continue automatically in %0 seconds. Press Stay on this page or Escape to cancel." - %0 is the number of seconds.

MOTION AND ACCESSIBILITY: every symbol is complete at rest; the animations only start from an earlier state. Under reduced motion nothing moves, confetti and the pulse ring are not shown and scenes are still. In forced-colors mode scenes and glow are removed and the symbol uses system colors. Keyboard: all actions are native links and buttons in DOM order; the heading is an h2 referenced by the region. Security stays server side: token checks, expiry, rate limits and neutral wording belong to page processes and validations.

templateOptions.name: Outcome - Email sent
templateOptions.help: Envelope with a paper plane landing on it, primary tone, kicker 'Email sent'. For reset links, verification mails and magic links. Leave all outcomes unticked for Success.

templateOptions.name: Outcome - Verified
templateOptions.help: Shield with a check and sparkles, success tone, kicker 'Verified'. For email, phone or identity verification.

templateOptions.name: Outcome - Signed out
templateOptions.help: Door with a leaving arrow, mirrored in right-to-left pages, info tone, kicker 'Signed out'.

templateOptions.name: Outcome - Link expired
templateOptions.help: Hourglass that has run out, warning tone, kicker 'Expired', role alert. For expired or already used links and codes.

templateOptions.name: Outcome - Error
templateOptions.help: Cross in a ring with a gentle shake, danger tone, kicker 'Error', role alert. Say what happened and how to fix it.

templateOptions.name: Outcome - Access denied
templateOptions.help: Lock whose shackle drops shut, danger tone, kicker 'Access denied', role alert.

templateOptions.name: Look - Minimal
templateOptions.help: No card: only the symbol, heading, text and actions on the page background. Leave the looks unticked for the default glass card.

templateOptions.name: Look - Split
templateOptions.help: Two-part card: the symbol on an outcome-colored gradient panel beside the text; the parts stack on narrow widths.

templateOptions.name: Look - Brutal
templateOptions.help: Neo-brutal card with an ink border, hard offset shadow, tilted symbol block and a bold heading.

templateOptions.name: Scene - Aurora
templateOptions.help: Slowly drifting aurora light in the outcome and primary colors behind the whole page.

templateOptions.name: Scene - Meteors
templateOptions.help: Meteors streak diagonally across the page background.

templateOptions.name: Scene - Grid
templateOptions.help: A fine panning line grid that fades out towards the edges, with an outcome-colored glow in the middle.

templateOptions.name: Scene - Mesh
templateOptions.help: A soft mesh gradient of the outcome, primary and info colors that shifts slowly.

templateOptions.name: Scene - Retro
templateOptions.help: A retro perspective grid floor moving towards the viewer under a striped setting sun.

templateOptions.name: Scene - Particles
templateOptions.help: Soft glowing dots drift upwards behind the page.

templateOptions.name: Confetti burst
templateOptions.help: A short confetti burst from the symbol after it is drawn, for the Success and Verified outcomes only; never under reduced motion.

templateOptions.name: Redirect after countdown
templateOptions.help: Needs the template script. After data-amc-seconds seconds, default 5, activates the first link or button in the region text, else the primary button. Pauses on hover, focus and hidden tab; a visible Stay on this page button and Escape cancel it.
